name: One official native neutralize mission against the joined enemy Governor

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local t=b.EnemyTarget(); local p=b.Probe(t.owner,t.city); if not p.canStart or #p.nativeTarget~=1 then error('official mission cannot target the joined Governor') end; b.Queue('SPY_MISSION',t); return 'one native neutralize request queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_SPY_MISSION' or a=='REJECTED_SPY_MISSION' or a=='UNKNOWN_SPY_MISSION' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_SPY_MISSION'
